summary: This is a routine earnings release 8-K filed by Willis Lease Finance Corp under Items 2.02 and 8.01. Item 2.02 reports the company's Q1 2026 financial results, and Item 8.01 announces a declared quarterly dividend of $0.40 per share, with payment on May 22, 2026 to holders of record on May 11, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign is described. The filing is a standard current report on operations and a regular dividend declaration, with no structural corporate change or extraordinary transaction.
